headline: Pop Mart Quarterly Sales Plunge 50% Amid Sharp Drop in Americas Demand
summary: Pop Mart reported steep quarterly revenue declines, including a 25% to 30% drop in China and a 70% to 75% plunge in sales across the Americas.
why: Pop Mart is a leading designer toy and pop culture merchandise retailer headquartered in China, relying on global consumer demand for novelty collectibles.

impacts.name: Pop Mart International Group
impacts.why: Sharp revenue drops in primary markets undermine investor revenue growth expectations.

why_moved: A severe decline in Americas sales signals weakening consumer demand for the company's flagship merchandise.
